snippet.title: Legends of the Round Table - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer and release date announcement for Legends of the Round Table, a colourful, Arthurian RPG full of honor, magic and romance. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom when it comes to Steam on 29th September 2025.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Legendsoftheroundtable
